newsitem.title: USA: INSTANT VIEW - U.S. Feb trade gap $11.59 billion.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - U.S. Feb trade gap $11.59 billion.

text.p: Following are comments from U.S. experts after the Commerce Department said the February trade gap stood at $11.59 billion, down from a revised $12.67 billion gap in January.
Experts in a Reuters poll had expected a $10.1 billion deficit in February.

DAVID SLOAN, SENIOR ECONOMIST, I.D.E.A. INC: "Exports and imports are both strong but the gap is larger than expected. Exports are strong but imports are still rising. This may cause first-quarter (growth) forecasts to be revised down."
